test_bbb_enn_regression: test the BBB ENN model with regression mode using 10 training batches
test_bbb_enn_classification: test the BBB ENN model with classification mode using 10 training batches
run_bbb_test: run the BBB ENN test suite with parameterized hiddens and regression settings
create_bbb_enn_model: create a BBB ENN model using make_bbb_enn with base output sizes and dummy input
test_supervised_experiment: test a supervised experiment by creating it with make_test_experiment and training for 10 batches
